opening.argument: The platform is presented as a real online earning opportunity with unusually strong income and safety assurances. The speaker claims, “I earned approximately 3.5 million rupees,” while describing it as a blockchain trading platform that “is never ruined.” Participation is expressly tied to investment: “Here we have to make a small investment.” The promotional framing is reinforced by the display identifying Forsage as a “Real earning platform” alongside “100% Profit,” and by the invitation to contact the promoter on WhatsApp for more information. Taken together, these features encourage viewers to participate through promised profitability, investment access, and assurances of durability, rather than offering an investigative or cautionary account.

citations.quote: This is a foreshared blockchain trading platform. It is never ruined.
Here we have to make a small investment.
